    Venezuela defeated Trinidad and Tobago 4-1 on March 27, 2026
    , in a FIFA Series international friendly held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, according to reports from ESPN and FIFA+. Delvin Alfonzo was a standout scorer, helping La Vinotinto dominate the game after a competitive start, noted VAVEL.com. 
    Key Match Details (March 27, 2026): 
    • Result: Venezuela 4-1 Trinidad and Tobago, per YouTube.
    • Location: Pakhtakor Central Stadium, Tashkent, Uzbekistan, noted FIFA+.
    • Goalscorers: Delvin Alfonzo scored to break a 1-1 tie in the second half, says VAVEL.com.
    • Context: Part of the 2026 FIFA Series international friendlies, detailed in a YouTube video and reported by Sports Mole.
    • Lineups: Venezuela was led by coach Oswaldo Vizcarrondo, with a 4-4-2 formation, says BBC Sport. 
    Team News & Context 
    • Venezuela: The team displayed high offensive capacity, with players like Delvin Alfonzo driving the victory, per VAVEL.com.
    • Trinidad and Tobago: The Soca Warriors, managed by Angus Eve, featured key players such as Justin Garcia and Levi Garcia, according to Sports Mole. 
    This match is separate from the long-standing geopolitical relationship, where migrationpolicy.org notes thousands of Venezuelans have migrated to Trinidad and Tobago due to the crisis in their home country.
